agents_skill_none_body: Skills are files in the agent's folder. Add one here, or import a pack.
agents_skill_builtin_hint: One of Hermes's own skills. Hermes keeps it in step with its bundle, so it can be read, pinned and switched on or off here but not edited or deleted.
agents_skill_restore_body: Your changes to this skill are replaced by the version Core Hub ships. A skill you switched off stays off.
agents_skill_restored: %1$s is back to the library's version.
agents_skill_library_on: %1$s of %2$s skills in this profile — images, documents, data, research, translation, slides and schedules. Kept up to date until you edit one.
agents_skill_library_none: Not installed in this profile yet: %1$s skills — images, documents, data, research, translation, slides and schedules.
agents_skill_library_off: Off in this profile. Switch it on to install Core Hub's skills again.
agents_skill_library_off_title: Switch the Core Hub library off?
agents_skill_library_off_body: Its skills are removed from this profile, except the ones you edited, which stay as your own. Core Hub stops installing and updating them here until you switch it back on.
agents_skill_delete_body: The whole skill folder goes, with every file in it. Turning it off keeps everything.
agents_skill_key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore; it starts with a letter or a digit.
agents_skill_editor_note: This is what the agent reads, verbatim — front matter and body. Nothing is reshaped on save.
agents_skill_library_editor_note: One of Core Hub's own skills. Once you save a change it is yours: Core Hub stops updating it, and Restore brings its version back.
agents_skill_bundled_refused: This is one of Hermes's own skills; it is read-only here.
agents_skill_essential_refused: Hermes's own manual (hermes-agent) is always on: Hermes does not let it be switched off.
agents_skill_not_library: This skill is not one of Core Hub's own.
agents_skill_library_off_refused: The Core Hub library is off in this profile; switch it on first.
agents_skill_import_not_pack: Choose a SKILL.md file or a zip archive.
agents_import_pack_unrecognised: A skill pack is a SKILL.md file or a zip archive
agents_import_pack_path_unsafe: The archive has a path that would land outside its skill
agents_import_pack_unsupported: The archive uses something the hub does not read
agents_import_pack_too_large: The archive is too large once unpacked
agents_import_skill_too_large: SKILL.md is longer than Hermes reads
agents_import_skill_front_matter_missing: SKILL.md does not start with a front matter block (---)
agents_import_skill_front_matter_unclose: SKILL.md's front matter is not closed with ---
agents_import_skill_front_matter_invalid: SKILL.md's front matter is not valid YAML
agents_import_skill_name_required: SKILL.md's front matter has no name
agents_import_skill_description_required: SKILL.md's front matter has no description
agents_import_skill_description_too_long: The description is longer than Hermes reads
agents_import_skill_body_empty: SKILL.md has nothing after its front matter
agents_import_skill_name_invalid: The skill name is not one Hermes accepts
agents_import_skill_nested: A skill in the archive sits inside another skill
agents_import_skill_duplicate: The same skill is in the upload twice
agents_import_skill_exists: This profile already has this skill; delete it first to replace it
agents_memory_note: Three documents the agent reads when a conversation starts, so a change here reaches its next conversation. They are emptied by editing, never deleted.
agents_memory_about_soul: Who the agent is. Read at the start of every conversation.
agents_memory_about_memory: What it learned and chose to keep.
agents_memory_empty_soul: Not written yet — the agent has no particular character.
agents_memory_empty_user: It has written nothing about you yet.
agents_memory_entries_hint: A list of short entries, each separated by a line holding only §. It has a character limit: past it, the agent cannot add anything new.
agents_memory_too_long: Too long for this memory: %1$s characters, and the limit is %2$s. Shorten or merge entries.
agents_memory_budget_over: %1$s of %2$s characters — full: the agent cannot keep anything new
agents_memory_too_long_refused: Too long for this memory; shorten or merge entries.
agents_plugin_note: The plugins Hermes has in this profile, with Hermes's own status. One that is not enabled does not load — except the messaging platforms and model providers Hermes ships, which load when they are used. A change reaches the agent's next session.
agents_plugin_none_body: Hermes lists no plugin in this profile.
agents_plugin_install_hint: A name from Hermes's plugin catalog, owner/repo, or a Git URL. Hermes fetches it, scans it and installs it into this profile switched off; switch it on when you are ready.
agents_plugin_install_bad: One word with no spaces, not starting with a dash.
agents_plugin_remove_body: Its folder is removed from this profile's plugins. Switching it off keeps it.
agents_plugin_bundled_refused: This plugin ships with Hermes; switch it off instead of removing it.
agents_tools_not_supervised: This hub does not run Hermes itself, so it cannot ask Hermes to do this.
agents_card_remove_body: The hub removes this agent's program from the server. You can install it again later.
agents_card_update_available_untested: Update available: %1$s — newer than the tested version
